query:
SELECT p.lurker_tax_enabled AS "lurker_tax_enabled?",
                    p.lurker_pitch_enabled AS "lurker_pitch_enabled?",
                    COALESCE(p.twitch_user_id, '') AS "twitch_user_id!"
               FROM streamer_plans p
              WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p.twitch_login,'')) = $1
              LIMIT 1
